en.askTitle: Put in your own country, grades and savings and get the same UK master’s budget, with gaps and reserves shown
en.runTitle: Nigeria to a UK MSc in Data Science, September 2027, on a GBP 32,000 family budget

fields.label: Degree and grades
fields.value: BSc Computer Science from a Lagos university, 2:1 equivalent; wants a one-year MSc in Data Science outside London

fields.label: Savings and currency
fields.value: About GBP 32,000 family budget for tuition plus living

fields.label: Courses and written fees
fields.placeholder: e.g. MSc Data Science at a named university, GBP 17,000 on its fee page

fields.label: English evidence
fields.placeholder: e.g. IELTS 6.5 taken in 2026, or a WAEC English grade

fields.label: Confirmed scholarships
fields.placeholder: e.g. none yet, or a GBP 2,000 award in writing

fields.label: Family or post-study plans
fields.placeholder: e.g. coming alone, hoping to use the Graduate route afterwards

en.template: Plan my UK MSc from {country} for {intake}, using {degree}, {savings}, {courses}, {english}, {scholarships} and {plans}. Separate tuition, living, visa costs and reserves. Show funding gaps, document timing and questions to settle before paying. Plan only; do not contact anyone, apply or pay for me.

phases.title: Find programmes, fees and scholarships from official university and funder pages
phases.note: Example courses, tuition by year, and scholarship eligibility and dates
phases.judgment: It would not count a scholarship that does not apply. Teesside’s £2,000 award is for January 2027 entry only, with an offer needed by 1 November 2026, so it is left out of the September 2027 sums. Chevening (closed 6 October 2026) and the Commonwealth Master’s (closed 20 October 2026) are marked as already closed.

phases.title: Check the visa and money rules and build the cost and timeline assumptions
phases.note: Visa funds, health surcharge, TB test, Graduate route and the dated timeline
phases.judgment: It kept today’s rule apart from one already announced: living money for the visa is £1,171 a month now, rising to £1,203 for applications from 30 November 2026. The plan uses the higher figure (£14,436 for 12 months), which leaves a tuition ceiling of £17,564 within £32,000.

phases.title: Write the plan and source list, and have them independently checked
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recalculated all four programme totals, three scholarship scenarios and the living and Graduate-route figures, and reopened three sources to confirm sampled claims. Everything matched.

workers: Found affordable one-year Data Science master’s courses outside London and read their published international fees and entry requirements
Checked Chevening, Commonwealth and university scholarship rules, and which application dates are still open
Read the finished plan on its own, recalculated its figures and reopened sample sources to check them

zh.askTitle: 填入你自己的国家、成绩和存款，同样拿到英国硕士预算，缺口和储备一目了然
zh.runTitle: 尼日利亚到英国读数据科学硕士，2027 年 9 月入学，家庭预算 3.2 万英镑

fields.label: 学位和成绩
fields.value: 拉各斯一所大学的计算机科学学士，相当于 2:1；想读伦敦以外的一年制数据科学硕士

fields.label: 存款及币种
fields.value: 家庭预算约 3.2 万英镑，用于学费加生活费

fields.label: 候选课程和书面学费
fields.placeholder: 例如：某大学的数据科学硕士，学费页面写明 1.7 万英镑

fields.label: 英语材料
fields.placeholder: 例如：2026 年考的雅思 6.5，或 WAEC 英语成绩

fields.label: 已确认奖学金
fields.placeholder: 例如：暂无，或已有书面确认的 2,000 英镑奖学金

fields.label: 家属或毕业后计划
fields.placeholder: 例如：一个人去，毕业后想走毕业生签证

zh.template: 请按{country}、{intake}、{degree}、{savings}、{courses}、{english}、{scholarships}和{plans}，帮我安排英国硕士预算。分清学费、生活费、签证费和储备，列出资金缺口、文件准备时间，以及付款前要问清的问题。只做计划，不联系任何人、不代申请、不代付款。

phases.title: 从大学和资助方的官方页面找课程、学费和奖学金
phases.note: 示例课程、各学年学费，以及奖学金的资格和日期
phases.judgment: 它不会把不适用的奖学金算进去。提赛德大学的 2,000 英镑奖学金只适用于 2027 年 1 月入学，且要在 2026 年 11 月 1 日前拿到录取，所以 2027 年 9 月入学的算式里没有它。Chevening（2026 年 10 月 6 日截止）和英联邦硕士奖学金（2026 年 10 月 20 日截止）都标明已经截止。

phases.title: 核对签证和资金规则，建立费用与时间线假设
phases.note: 签证资金、医疗附加费、结核病检测、毕业生签证和带日期的时间线
phases.judgment: 它把现行规则和已公布的新规分开写：签证要求的生活费现在是每月 1,171 英镑，2026 年 11 月 30 日起的申请将升到 1,203 英镑。计划按较高的数字算（12 个月为 14,436 英镑），这样在 3.2 万英镑里，学费上限就是 17,564 英镑。

phases.title: 写成计划和来源清单，再请人独立复核
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事重新计算了全部 4 个课程的总额、3 种奖学金情形，以及生活费和毕业生签证相关的数字，还重新打开 3 个来源核对抽查的说法，结果全部吻合。

workers: 找出伦敦以外学费较低的一年制数据科学硕士课程，并读取它们公布的国际生学费和入学要求
核对 Chevening、英联邦奖学金和大学奖学金的规则，以及哪些申请日期还没过
单独通读成稿的计划，重新计算其中的数字，并重新打开部分来源核对
